title: ticfac Phase 7: cut over and simplify ticks
description: SPEC §12 Phase 7. Release ticfac and the required tk version/contracts together; remove Factory/cloud commands, packages, embedding, cloud image assets and Factory CI from ticks; remove duplicate execution/orchestration implementations while retaining tracker authoring policy, sandbox contracts, question state and the board; prove the dependency direction mechanically.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: ticks builds without ticfac; ticfac passes the contract bundle against a pinned ticks release. Project checkpoint.
